# Official PixiJS v8 agent skills

Copied unchanged (except SKILL.md → GUIDE.md renames so they load as references, not separate skills) from the `pixi.js@8.22.0` npm package (`skills/`), MIT licence – see `LICENSE`. Start at `pixijs/GUIDE.md` (router). In a project that has `pixi.js` ≥ 8.19 installed, the newest copies are in `node_modules/pixi.js/skills/`.
